annotations.title: Edit or archive a LinkedIn lead gen form

description: Edit a LinkedIn lead gen form — name, headline, description, questions, privacy policy, disclaimer, consents, thank-you message / button / landing page — or retire it with state:"ARCHIVED". LinkedIn allows every field while no running ad uses the form; once a live ad does, only headline, description, disclaimer, privacy policy, the thank-you fields and state can change, and anything else is refused here by name. Changing the QUESTIONS can break a CRM that already mapped the form, so tell the user. Read back from LinkedIn. Free.

adAccountId.description: ad account that owns the form; use this or pageId

consents.description: consent checkbox texts, or {text, required: true} for a mandatory one

description.description: form description shown under the headline

headline.description: title of the form people see

name.description: form name shown in Campaign Manager

pageId.description: Omit when one Page is shared

privacyPolicyUrl.description: privacy policy URL shown on the form

questions.description: the fields to ask, in order: predefined names LinkedIn prefills from the member profile (FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, WORK_EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, COMPANY_NAME, JOB_TITLE, SENIORITY, COMPANY_SIZE, INDUSTRY, CITY, COUNTRY, ZIP_CODE, LINKEDIN_PROFILE_LINK …; friendly spellings like "work email" work) and/or custom questions {question, type:"text", maxLength?} or {question, options:[2–15 choices]}

state.description: PUBLISHED keeps the form live; ARCHIVED retires it

thankYouCta.description: thank-you button label: visit website, learn more, view now, download or try now

thankYouMessage.description: message shown to the person after they submit the form
